title: Andrej Karpathy built HackerTube over a weekend
teaser: Andrej Karpathy built HackerTube with Claude Opus 5.5: it processed 43 million comments posted over Hacker News’s 20-year history and selected 6,454 videos recommended there. Karpathy says they are more convenient to watch than videos recommended by YouTube. The service requires no account, shows a frame from the middle of each video instead of a custom thumbnail, and stores viewing data in the browser. Karpathy then built TristanTube; he says Claude Code handled it in one run and three minutes. The collection includes 47,000 videos from channels on Tristan Hume’s list.
